                              {prepare,start,resume,evaluate,report,gpu_check,admit-e-prepare,admit-e-start,admit-e-resume,score-predictions,simulate-online,monitor-online,describe-composition}

Prepare, train, evaluate S3-V2 and simulate frozen Actors on live DB bars.

positional arguments:
  {prepare,start,resume,evaluate,report,gpu_check,admit-e-prepare,admit-e-start,admit-e-resume,score-predictions,simulate-online,monitor-online,describe-composition}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --prepared PREPARED
  --run-dir RUN_DIR
  --stop-at STOP_AT
  --verify-resume-only  Internal bounded E cold-resume next-update probe;
                        publishes no checkpoint
  --eval-steps EVAL_STEPS
  --eval-dir EVAL_DIR   Existing sealed Actor-only evaluation for CPU post-
                        processing
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Prediction scoring directory or online monitor
                        observations
  --runner-pid RUNNER_PID
                        Online runner PID for optional process health checks
  --interval INTERVAL   Online monitor sampling interval in seconds
  --once                Sample the online monitor once
  --json                Print online console events as JSON
  --until UNTIL         Optional online monitor end time (ISO); default is
                        continuous
  --check-only          Online DB/model/RPC preflight; emits no orders
  --resume-online       Restore the same online account and policy carry
  --authorize-training  Explicit user authorization for formal 1M
                        start/resume; diagnostics do not require it
